==Dialogue==
{{section-stub}}
''Note: The dialogue response is dependent on your progress in the ''Nightfall'' campaign storyline.''

;After completion of the [[Chahbek Village]] mission
:''"I remember when [[Kormir]] was but a young officer. You remind me much of her."''
:''"I see you're advancing in your studies, <player name>. Well done!"''
:''"I tried the <player's profession> [[profession]] once, but it didn't suit me. You are far better at it than I."''
:''"Maybe someday you'll be [[Spearmarshal]]. Kormir's got to grow old someday."''
:''"Sunspears need all professions to keep Istan safe."''

;After completion of the [[Jokanur Diggings]] mission
:''"I'm not afraid of death! Or undeath either."''
:''"Something dark looms in those ruins. Balthazar guide my spear as I fight for Istan."''
:''"Those ruins send a shiver up my back. Ahai, a Sunspear should not be frightened of legend. I am ashamed of myself."''
:''"We'll take back those ruins and drive out the evil spirits."''
:''"Will you fight by my side in the ruins? I would feel better knowing you are there, friend."''

;After completion of the [[Blacktide Den]] mission
:''"After those ruins, fighting Kournans seems almost easy."''
:''"Grenth curse the lot of those Kournans!"''
:''"Kournans? They fight like children. What do we have to be afraid of?"''
:''"My fellows think this battle will be simple. I have seen Kournans in combat. Do not underestimate them, or Istan will fall."''
:''"We will make war on these Kournans, and they will never forget their defeat."''

;After completion of the [[Consulate Docks]] mission
:''"Are the Elders cowards?"''
:''"I haven't seen my brother in days. Most of my friends are missing. I hope they're still alive."''
:''"I will fight those [[Kourna]]ns to a standstill...as soon as my wounds heal."''
:''"Kormir fought to protect [[Istan]], and now the country turns its back on her."''
:''"Those Kournans fight like lions. It should have been me who died, not my friends."''

;After completion of the [[Moddok Crevice]] mission
:''"I don't know if [[Vabbi]] will help us, but I am tired of fighting these Kournans alone."''
:''"If we can get to Vabbi, we will surely find allies there."''
:''"Make for Vabbi with all haste. We are doomed without allies."''
:''"Vabbi may offer allies...but do we really trust artists to fight our wars?"''
:''"Vabbi's guard is strong. It must be if the Kournans decided to attack Istan first!"''

;After completion of the [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] mission
:''"Ahai, Sunspear! These days are troubling. Have you heard any good news?"''
:''"I dreamed I was fighting Kournans, my friends strewn dead on the field around me. Then I saw a face within a Kournan helm.... It was my own."''
:''"Many of the Sunspears complain of nightmares. I don't have any. I don't sleep."''
:''"My head is killing me. Such headaches...and awful nightmares, too."''
:''"Nightfall is only a legend. Do not concern yourself with children's tales."''

;After completion of the [[Ruins of Morah]] mission
:''"Even in the face of Nightfall, a Sunspear should never give up."''
:''"I still don't believe in Nightfall. There's no such thing as the end of the world. It's all foolishness."''
:''"If I am to die, let me die fighting. I plan to meet Balthazar with a spear in my hand."''
:''"Perhaps I was wrong about Nightfall. Everything seems so hopeless."''
:''"The corsairs need good sailors. Do you think we can escape Nightfall by sea?"''

;After completion of the [[Abaddon's Gate]] mission
:''"I found my brother in a Kournan prison garrison. He's fine, and free again!"''
:''"The day breaks, the sun returns, and the Sunspears bring glory to Istan!"''
:''"The Sunspears are heroes, and Istan is safe. All is right with the world."''
:''"This is the new golden age of the Sunspears."''
:''"[[Varesh Ossa]] was the worst villain in Istani history. It took our greatest heroes to defeat her."''

==Notes==

*Elementalist and Mesmer versions don't fight back when under attack.
